verdict.rationale: Salv's API docs say the API definition can be downloaded as a YAML file at https://docs.salv.com/api/public.yaml for import into Postman. Content from that file (environment selection, endpoint semantics) is itself quoted, which confirms it is a real, fetchable machine-readable spec, and the docs refer to it as an 'open API'. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of the spec format or version (e.g. OpenAPI 3.x), and independent or hands-on corroboration of downloading and using the spec.
